name: Creatify
description_en:
Creatify is an AI advertising-creative platform combining product-link video generation, avatars, image/video tools and campaign-oriented workflows. Ad discovery, generation, account-connected launch and performance analysis are different stages; a generated ad is not evidence that it converts or is accepted by an advertising platform.

A useful first task is to turn an owned product page into a reviewed ad variant, checking the extracted product facts and message before choosing an avatar and export. API access and managed creative services have separate commercial scopes.
description_zh:
Creatify 是AI广告素材平台，结合产品链接生成视频、虚拟人物、图像／视频工具及广告活动流程。广告发现、生成、连接账户投放和效果分析是不同阶段，生成广告不证明能转化或被广告平台接受。

首个实用任务可将自有产品页转为经核对广告变体，先检查提取的产品事实和文案，再选虚拟人物及导出。API访问和托管创意服务另有商业范围。

sections.title_en: Verify the script against the product page
sections.en:
The URL-to-video page describes extracting product details and assets from a link, choosing an avatar and customizing the generated result. The pricing FAQ also permits uploading images, video and text. Review claims, units, offers and licensing of each imported asset; an extraction or script generator can reproduce stale information or invent an unsupported benefit.

For a pilot, use a simple owned product, compare two different hooks while keeping the factual offer unchanged and inspect caption/voice timing before export. The site’s performance testimonials and short production-time claims are vendor marketing, not measured results from this research. No ad was generated or launched.
sections.zh:
URL-to-video页说明从链接提取产品详情和素材、选择虚拟人物并定制结果；价格FAQ还允许上传图片、视频和文字。应检查主张、单位、优惠及每个导入素材的许可，提取或脚本生成可能复用过时信息或编造不被支持的卖点。

试点可用简单自有产品，保持事实优惠不变、比较两个开头，再在导出前检查字幕／声音时序。官网效果评价及短制作时间是厂商营销，不是本文测得结果，本文未生成或投放广告。

sections.title_en: An edit and a regeneration have different costs
sections.title_zh: 编辑与重新生成收费不同
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ says manual text, caption, trim, media and layout edits to an exported project can be re-exported free; rerunning AI video, avatar, voice or script is a new credited generation. Cost varies with model, length and resolution and is shown before generation. Credits remain valid for two months rather than rolling over forever.

Free provides10 monthly credits with watermarked exports. Displayed individual plan cards pair regular15/55/95 with discounted10/38/66 dollars per month under an annual promotion and55/280/730 monthly credits. The final annual invoice and renewal were not exposed clearly, so payable pricing remains unverified. Do not translate a model-specific video-count example into a guaranteed number of complete ad campaigns.
sections.zh:
价格FAQ说明，已导出项目的文字、字幕、裁切、媒体及布局手动修改可免费再导出；重跑AI视频、虚拟人物、声音或脚本属于新生成并消耗额度。费用随模型、时长及分辨率不同，生成前显示，额度有效两个月，并非永久结转。

Free每月10额度，导出带水印。个人方案在年付促销下将常规15／55／95与优惠10／38／66美元月价并列，对应每月55／280／730额度，但最终年付账单和续费未清晰显示，实收价格仍未核。不能将模型特定视频数量示例等同保证完成的广告活动数量。

sections.title_en: Website credits and API products need separate budgets
sections.title_zh: 网页额度和API产品需分别预算
sections.en:
The API cards list Starter at USD99/month with500 API credits and Pro299 with2000, while enterprise volume terms are negotiated. Requests require an API ID, API key and sufficient allowance. Generation endpoints consume credits; simple GET/LIST calls do not, and insufficient balance can stop job creation or processing. Website/API balances and full endpoint parity were not established.

Custom avatar creation is described as using avatar capacity rather than generation credits, with extra slots available separately. For automation, retain job identifiers, inspect terminal status and actual costs before retrying a failed render. This research made no API request and did not verify refund, cancellation or duplicate-generation handling.
sections.zh:
API卡列Starter每月99美元含500 API额度，Pro299含2000，企业量价协商。请求需要API ID、API key及足够额度；生成端点收费，普通GET／LIST不收费，余额不足可使任务创建或处理停止。本文未确认网页／API余额是否互通或全部端点是否等价。

自定义虚拟人物创建描述为使用人物容量而非生成额度，额外槽位另购。自动化应保留任务标识，重试失败渲染前检查最终状态和实际费用。本文未调用API，未验证退款、取消或重复生成处理。

sections.title_en: Separate generated content from advertising approval
sections.title_zh: 区分生成内容与广告审批
sections.en:
The product promotes launch and performance tools for connected ad accounts. Those integrations require their own access and configuration; no ad spend, measurement attribution or return on investment was verified. Content and likeness permissions remain relevant even when stock media is described as royalty-free.

The site’s language counts vary across avatar and platform descriptions, so validate the intended voice/language combination rather than assuming every model supports the same set. Legal commercial-use, avatar-consent and enterprise IP terms were not inspected. No source license for the hosted platform was verified, and Chinese profile text does not establish a particular localized interface.
sections.zh:
产品宣传连接广告账户后的投放及分析工具，这些集成需要各自权限和配置，本文未核广告花费、归因或投资回报。即使素材被称为免版税，内容及肖像授权仍需核对。

虚拟人物与平台描述中的语言数量不同，应验证目标声音／语言组合，不能假定每个模型支持同样语言集。未查商业使用、人物同意及企业IP法律条款，也未核托管平台源码许可；档案中文不证明特定本地化界面。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Illustrative evaluation steps were not executed.
